captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a recumbent trike front fork and steering assembly. It features a wide, squared-crown fork blade pair with two straight, round legs extending downward, finished in matte black. A threaded steerer tube rises vertically, supporting a forward-swept bullhorn handlebar pair clamped via a stem extension tip pinch collar. The entire steering assembly is designed to pivot on a nearly vertical revolute joint relative to the head tube, allowing realistic steering articulation.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a recumbent trike front fork and steering assembly. The model should include a squared-crown fork with straight round legs, a threaded steerer tube, and a forward-swept bullhorn handlebar clamped to the stem, with a revolute joint representing the steering axis.
captions.factory: The code constructs the assembly using an ArticulatedObject. The fixed frame/head-tube component is defined first. A revolute articulation is then created on a nearly vertical axis, linking the head tube to the steering fork assembly. The fork is built by combining a box-shaped crown with cylindrical legs and a threaded steerer cylinder. The bullhorn handlebars and clamping stem are modeled using swept profiles and cylindrical primitives, then joined to the steerer tube.
